description: Applies the transformation_rules defined in the adapter integration config to normalize and remap the raw API response into a canonical output format. Runs immediately after a successful adapter response is received. Supports field renaming, JSON path extraction, type casting, value defaulting, and nested object flattening. Enables the downstream pipeline stages to work with a consistent data structure regardless of which external API was called — abstracting away API-specific response format differences between CIBIL, Experian, Karza, and other adapters.
use_cases: Normalizing credit score field names across CIBIL and Experian adapters
Extracting nested JSON paths from complex bureau API responses
Type casting string scores to integers for downstream processing
Flattening deeply nested GST return history arrays
Applying default values for optional response fields that were not returned
when_to_use: Attach to all adapters. Transformation rules are defined per-adapter in the integration config and applied here.
trigger_condition: Immediately after a successful adapter API response is received

input_parameters.description: Raw JSON response from the external adapter API
Config-defined rules for field mapping, type casting, and extraction
Client tenant ID for per-client rule isolation

output.on_success: transformed_response (normalized) with transformation_summary of every applied rule
output.on_failure: raw_response passed through unchanged; transformation_failure logged

error_codes.HOOK_001: Invalid JSON path expression in rules.
